newsitem.title: SPAIN: Aznar says EU forecasts support Spain's EMU drive.
newsitem.headline: Aznar says EU forecasts support Spain's EMU drive.

text.p: Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Thursday EU Commission forecasts would lend Spain support in its drive to join the launch of Europe's single currency and that he was convinced Spain would adhere to the criteria.
"We have passed from not fulfilling any criteria one year ago to meeting three out of five. I am convinced that this year Spain will meet them (the criteria) comfortably," Aznar told journalists.

The EU Commission released budget deficit forecasts on Wednesday. It said Spain would meet its goal of lowering its deficit to three percent of gross domestic product this year, the reference value in the Maastricht Treaty, from 4.4 percent in 1996.
The EU commission told Spain: "You Spanish, are doing your homework well," Aznar said.
Aznar said Spain would meet the convergence criteria with rigour, adding that the budget goal would not be altered.
"There is not going to be any review in budget goals, because these are being rigorously fulfilled," Aznar said.
